newsitem.title: USA: Huaneng Power output ahead of schedule.
newsitem.headline: Huaneng Power output ahead of schedule.

text.p: Huaneng Power International Inc said power generation of its five operating power plants was 15.4 billion kilowatt hours for the year through November 28, surpassing the planned power generation of 15.35 billion KWh for 1996, the company said in a statement released in New York Tuesday.

Huaneng said its planned power plant projects are also progressing smoothly. One of the units of the Shantou, coal-fired plant was officially put into operation on November 29, it said. The second unit of the Shantou Plant is conducting its 168 hours of full load trial operation and will be in service shortly.
Upon the completion of the two units, the company's total operating capacity will increase to 3,500 megawatts from 2,900, it said.

The company said it believes the two 300 megawatt units of Shangan Phase Two will be brought on line in 1997. By the end of 1997, the company estimates its total installed capacity will be 4,100 megawatts. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
